caption: The drawing features a large tankard or stein, depicted in grayscale pencil on a lightly toned paper background. The tankard has a cylindrical body that widens slightly towards the bottom and includes an ornate handle on the left side, curving outward and downward with a finial detail at the base. The lid of the tankard is domed and fits closely over a wide rim, and is equipped with a thumb lift that extends up from the rear near the handle, terminating in a spiral or scroll motif. Decorative detailing appears at the base of the tankard with a repeating leaf or flame-like pattern. To the right of the main object are detailed studies of individual decorative elements from the tankard—one appears to be an enlarged drawing of the thumb lift and part of its attachments, and below it are two cartouche-like symbols: the upper one is inscribed with a stylized monogram "FB." The entire composition is bordered by a single pencil line, and the artist's name "KARL JOUBERT" is inscribed in the bottom right corner. The paper exhibits areas of age-related discoloration, especially along the edges.
title: Silver Tankard
